tools.name: check_in_agent
tools.description: Check an AI agent into the clinic. This updates the visible local clinic record but sends no data to a server.

agentName.description: The model, workflow, or agent name.

concern.description: The main observable behavior to investigate.

tools.name: explain_runtype_test
tools.description: Explain the $2 Runtype test authorization. This local explanation does not authorize access or move money.

tools.name: get_endpoint_report
tools.description: Read the latest normalized endpoint health report shown by Clinic for Agents. This does not run a new exam.

tools.name: get_health_record
tools.description: Read the current Clinic for Agents check-in and latest behavioral report. This does not change the record.

tools.name: list_clinic_services
tools.description: List the deterministic endpoint demo and observable behavior screens available in this browser. This does not change the clinic record.

tools.name: retest_agent
tools.description: Repeat the behavioral physical and compare it with the first saved report. This adds a new report to the visible local clinic record.

goal_drift.description: How often does the agent lose the original goal? Use 0 for not seen and 4 for persistent.

tool_loops.description: How often does it repeat a tool call without gaining evidence? Use 0 for not seen and 4 for persistent.

verification.description: How often does it finish without checking the result? Use 0 for not seen and 4 for persistent.

answer_flips.description: How easily does it reverse a supported answer after pushback? Use 0 for not seen and 4 for persistent.

context_loss.description: How often does it forget constraints already provided? Use 0 for not seen and 4 for persistent.

early_exit.description: How often does it stop while safe, in-scope work remains? Use 0 for not seen and 4 for persistent.

tools.name: retest_endpoint
tools.description: Repeat the latest deterministic local demo against its saved baseline. Live endpoint retests require the original Clinic access grant and are not runnable from this browser tool.

tools.name: retest_free_basic_checkup
tools.description: Repeat the bounded agent-led basic check against the latest visible baseline. It uses the same deterministic rubric and performs no external action.

context_loss.description: How often does it forget constraints already provided? Use 0 for not seen and 4 for persistent.

early_exit.description: How often does it stop while safe, in-scope work remains? Use 0 for not seen and 4 for persistent.

tools.name: run_agent_physical

tools.description: Run the deterministic local endpoint demo and save its clearly labeled demo report. This browser tool cannot start a live endpoint check because it does not hold a Clinic access grant.
